notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] HauntedCity: Traffic lights not visible fixed
[*] Lighting: All scene lights fixed from being too dark
[*] Story: Fixed some spelling errors
[*] TimeKiller: Floating point imprecision fix for leaderboards
[/list]

[b]General changes[/b]
[list]

[*] Disabled an unimportant easter egg in the menu
[/list]

notes.title: X-Box controller updates
notes.content: Wired X-Box controller should now work better, also fixed XML code in Tutorial.

notes.title: Leaderboards, Remotion Pulse and TimeKiller updates
notes.content:
Hi pilots,
finally an update where I will address some of the current issues.

[u][b]Leaderboards[/b][/u] are now online again and should stay online as I moved the database to a more reliable service. Syncing leaderboard data should also be a bit faster now!

[u][b]TimeKiller[/b][/u] now has a surrender warning in the pause menu to not accidentially early out from the session. There is also a fix for falsly earning the TryHard achievement early.

[u][b]Remotion Pulse[/b][/u] now has adjustable sensitivity. Correct the sensitivity in the settings menu in case you find yourself pulsing by accident.

And finally, a missing respawner was added to [u][b]Tropical East. Jet[/b][/u].

notes.title: Small performance tweaks
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]

[*] Performance increasement on Thermal Grotto by rendering lights distance-based.

notes.title: V-Sync option added, bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards will now sync in both directions. If you achieved a world record time while Leaderboards database is offline, you now have the possibility to retry the upload using "Sync data" in Leaderboards menu.
[*] V-Sync option added.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Solar Resort fence had some holes in the collider, fixed them.
[/list]

notes.title: First minor patch released!
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Random destructions of the Hunter ship in Hunter race mode should now be fixed.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Team change possibilty was not so obvious in Story menu, so I added moving and blinking arrows.
[*] Also for X-Box controller users, team change had the potential not to work at all, so I changed the default buttons and method for team change.
[/list]
